narration.hook: Before a health claim, ask: what did the study actually measure?
narration.body: Pinealon is a synthetic tripeptide: glutamic acid, aspartic acid and arginine. A published cell study examined oxidative stress and cell survival. These laboratory findings do not establish a safe or effective treatment in people, or demonstrate improved sleep. DUSK brings the research questions together. Explore the evidence and its limits. Laboratory research only. Not for human use.
